job.name: ig22_guest
job.meaning: гость ток-шоу ~32, короткая стрижка, аккуратная борода, тёмно-синий свитер на молнии, белая футболка, синий диван
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic photo, like a real frame from a TV talk show camera. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, гость ток-шоу на диване, ночной город, без текста; взгляд чуть в сторону (на ведущего) — задумано
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. A calm self-assured Russian man about 32, short dark brown hair, a neat short beard, a dark navy knitted zip-neck sweater over a white t-shirt, sitting relaxed on a deep blue velvet guest sofa, hands loosely together, turned slightly to his left towards the host, looking just past the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm confident expression with a hint of a smile. Medium shot from the waist up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge. Background: the same late-night show studio — large windows onto a night city skyline with lit skyscrapers, blue and warm amber accent lights, softly blurred.
